title: Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.00574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). translated_title: 让稀疏奖励发挥作用：面向多奖励强化学习的密度感知奖励聚合
translated_abstract: 多奖励强化学习训练大语言模型以同时满足多个行为目标。正如GDPO中使用的按奖励归一化，它在rollout组内保留了各奖励特有的相对信息，但不同目标仍可能表现出学习进度不均衡。我们通过优势能量来研究这一现象，即一个奖励在一个批次上的优势平方和。在理想化的GDPO归一化下，我们证明该能量与活跃组密度成正比：即该奖励提供非零相对优势的rollout组所占的比例。这揭示了批次层面残留的信号不均衡，并为校准奖励贡献提供了依据。基于这一关系，我们提出了密度感知奖励聚合。我们推导出一种逆平方根密度校正，为较少活跃的奖励的信号赋予更大权重。DARA根据每个奖励的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出密度感知奖励聚合（DARA），利用优势能量与活跃组密度成正比这一发现，通过逆平方根密度校正为低频活跃的稀疏奖励赋予更大权重，从而解决多奖励强化学习中不同目标间信号不均衡的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA), which leverages the discovery that advantage energy is proportional to active-group density and applies an inverse-square-root density correction to upweight less frequently active (sparse) rewards, addressing signal imbalance across objectives in multi-reward RL.
